Who we are

Chimcare Service Locations

Browse by stateSchedule Service

At Chimcare, we pride ourselves on providing top-quality chimney sweeping, repair, and masonry services to homeowners across multiple states.

Our dedicated teams in Washington, Oregon, Ohio, California, and Massachusetts are here to help keep your chimneys and fireplaces safe, efficient, and in great condition — and our New England crew also covers New Hampshire and Rhode Island. We've since grown to serve homeowners across 20 states in all, from the Midwest to the mid-Atlantic. Each region runs its own crew, so the technician on your roof already knows the local climate, the local building stock and the codes that apply to it.

  • Sweeping & inspectionCreosote removal, three-level inspections and draft checks
  • Repair & masonryCrowns, caps, flashing, liners, tuckpointing and rebuilds
  • WaterproofingProtection against moisture damage in wet climates
  • Gas fireplacesInstallation, repair and maintenance year-round

Experienced Technicians
